text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hmm, your skin's breaking out worse than before.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: No wonder my friends and juniors have been giving me skincare products lately.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...For their sake too,
I gotta use what I got and heal up quick.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thankful for the kindness of those around her,
Katsuragi Ace began to face her skin troubles head-on...
